text: For seed 21 (N=64, m2 fixed, data_seed 1), trained force R2 at step 6000 is about 0.807 in the 12000-step run but 0.8376 in the 6000-step run, while seed 20 agrees within 0.005. Is the difference the lr-schedule horizon (the 6000-step run decays sooner) or seed-specific? Would comparing at matched schedule fraction (step 6000 of 12000 vs step 3000 of 6000) bring the two seed 21 runs within 0.01?
